definitions.whole: raw first1024 clean points, no augmentation/overwrite; eval BN
definitions.part: one deterministic local kNN patch per object/size; sizes200/400/600 share one centre
definitions.near_native_percent: 100*mean(radius>=0.99599); c1 native float32 projection radius is approximately0.996
definitions.d0: 2*atanh(||mu||), c1 FP64 geometry from unchanged FP32 embeddings
definitions.part_prediction: auxiliary whole-class label agreement; no semantic part labels or part accuracy claim
definitions.probe_ranges: means/min/max of four fixed-batch summaries; observed sensitivity, not confidence intervals
definitions.probe_bn_delta_sign: regrouped local32 minus contiguous local32, negative IDs fixed
definitions.probe_buffers: clean64 inference after two no-update local BN forwards; variants both grouping schemes and local ranks
definitions.epoch: raw checkpoint epoch retained; completed epoch stored explicitly or externally declared
definitions.training_vs_diagnostic_seed: original training4780, new sourceB32/B64 training22; all clean/patch/probe diagnostic seed22

limitations: Clean fixed-size patch statistics are not randomized training-mode telemetry.
Single seeds, different batch/update/RNG streams prevent isolating a training causal effect.
Post-step probe naming means two BN forwards only; no optimizer step occurred.
Probe regrouping tests conditional checkpoint sensitivity, not a replay of full distributed training.
